subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add first-class user OAuth credentials for reactions, native uploads, reaction typing, and proactive DM/email-alias lookup, and what secret/scope model should it use?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting user OAuth changes the channel credential, consent, scope, token-refresh, and operation-routing security boundary, which needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth Design
options.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth credential schema, SecretRef/redaction behavior, scoped clients, fallback semantics, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Limit Current Work To Fallbacks
options.body: Land only narrow mitigations such as media text-link fallback and keep reactions, native uploads, reaction typing, and proactive email-alias DMs unsupported until OAuth is separately sponsored.

options.title: Defer Bundled OAuth Surface
options.body: Leave the official plugin service-account-only for now and request an external plugin or design proposal if maintainers do not want this credential surface bundled.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth Design
recommendation.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth credential schema, SecretRef/redaction behavior, scoped clients, fallback semantics, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from prior review on this exact issue and sustained Google Chat auth/API/docs history.
